phases.name: The World Turns
phases.say: (The ground under everyone's feet begins, very slowly, to move.)

say.open: (The hillside opens its eyes. It is not a hillside.)
say.death: (She lies back down, and is a hillside again, and is quiet.)

bestiary.lore: The card of completion: the World herself, risen in the Dragon Reaches, the mother of every pool the rift has opened.
bestiary.weakness: Wind, heavily. She is slow; strike between the shifts, and dispel her cradle.
bestiary.pattern: Every fourth turn she cradles herself (Regen, Protect); every third the continents shift over four rows; root and stone on a row between, and her hand on the nearest. When the world turns, the shift comes every other turn.
